latestVersion.changelog:
AI Video Generator Sora 1.0.0 — Initial release

- Instantly generate 1080p MP4 videos from simple text prompts, no editing skills required.
- Supports text prompt uploads (TXT, DOCX, PDF, PNG, up to 200MB); just describe what you want to see.
- Automates all cloud session setup, including free starter tokens for new users.
- Simple commands to check credits, monitor status, and download finished videos.
- Built-in error handling and status updates for a seamless experience.
- Designed for fast, creator-friendly workflows: upload, generate, and export in minutes.
